changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO arr_async_request (async_request_id, type, priority, access_point_id) SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY access_point_id) + (SELECT coalesce( (SELECT max(async_request_id) FROM arr_async_request), 0)), 'AP', 1, access_point_id FROM ap_access_point WHERE state = 'ERROR'

changeSet.author: ppy
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ext_syncs_queue_item(ext_syncs_queue_item_id, access_point_id, external_system_id, state, date) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bs.access_point_id) + (select dhs.next_val from db_hibernate_sequences dhs where dhs.sequence_name = 'ext_syncs_queue_item|ext_syncs_queue_item_id'), bs.access_point_id, aes.external_system_id, 'UPDATE' as state, now() as date FROM ap_external_system aes JOIN ap_binding bnd on bnd.external_system_id = aes.external_system_id JOIN ap_binding_state bs on bs.binding_id = bnd.binding_id and bs.delete_change_id is null and bs.ext_state in ('ERS_APPROVED', 'ERS_NEW') LEFT JOIN ap_state st on st.access_point_id = bs.access_point_id and st.delete_change_id is null WHERE aes."type" = 'CAM_COMPLETE' AND st.access_point_id is null
UPDATE db_hibernate_sequences SET next_val = (SELECT (coalesce(max(ext_syncs_queue_item_id), 0)+20) FROM ext_syncs_queue_item) WHERE sequence_name = 'ext_syncs_queue_item|ext_syncs_queue_item_id'

changeSet.author: ppy
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM ap_cached_access_point WHERE access_point_id IN (SELECT s.access_point_id FROM ap_state s WHERE s.delete_change_id IS NULL GROUP BY s.access_point_id HAVING COUNT(s.state_id) > 1)

UPDATE ap_state s SET delete_change_id = update_state.create_change_id FROM ( WITH src as ( SELECT st.state_id, st.access_point_id, st.create_change_id, src.state_id last_state_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY st.access_point_id ORDER BY st.state_id ) pos FROM ap_state st JOIN ( SELECT s.access_point_id, max(s.state_id) as state_id FROM ap_state s WHERE s.delete_change_id IS NULL GROUP BY s.access_point_id HAVING COUNT(s.state_id) > 1) src ON src.access_point_id = st.access_point_id ) SELECT prev.state_id, next.create_change_id FROM src prev JOIN src next ON next.access_point_id = prev.access_point_id AND next.pos = prev.pos + 1 ) update_state WHERE s.state_id = update_state.state_id
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ap_state_delete_change_null_unique_idx ON ap_state(access_point_id) WHERE delete_change_id IS NULL

changeSet.author: ppy
changeSet.sql: WITH latest_ap_state AS ( SELECT access_point_id, delete_change_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY access_point_id ORDER BY create_change_id DESC) AS rn FROM ap_state ), invalidated_ap AS ( SELECT access_point_id FROM latest_ap_state WHERE rn = 1 AND delete_change_id IS NOT NULL ), to_enqueue AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fv.fund_version_id, n.node_id FROM arr_node n JOIN arr_fund_version fv ON fv.fund_id = n.fund_id AND fv.lock_change_id IS NULL JOIN arr_level l ON l.node_id = n.node_id AND l.delete_change_id IS NULL JOIN arr_desc_item di ON di.node_id = n.node_id JOIN arr_item itm ON itm.item_id = di.item_id AND itm.delete_change_id IS NULL JOIN arr_data_record_ref rr ON rr.data_id = itm.data_id JOIN invalidated_ap iap ON iap.access_point_id = rr.record_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arr_async_request r WHERE r.type = 'NODE' AND r.node_id = n.node_id ) ) INSERT INTO arr_async_request (async_request_id, type, priority, fund_version_id, node_id) SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY node_id) + (SELECT coalesce(max(async_request_id), 0) FROM arr_async_request), 'NODE', 1, fund_version_id, node_id FROM to_enqueue
UPDATE db_hibernate_sequences SET next_val = (SELECT (coalesce(max(async_request_id), 0)+20) FROM arr_async_request) WHERE sequence_name = 'arr_async_request|async_request_id'

changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM arr_cached_node WHERE node_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ii.node_id FROM arr_inhibited_item ii WHERE ii.delete_change_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arr_item ai WHERE ai.desc_item_object_id = ii.desc_item_object_id AND ai.delete_change_id IS NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arr_item ai WHERE ai.desc_item_object_id = ii.desc_item_object_id AND ai.delete_change_id IS NOT NULL ) )

UPDATE arr_inhibited_item ii SET delete_change_id = ( SELECT MAX(ai.delete_change_id) FROM arr_item ai WHERE ai.desc_item_object_id = ii.desc_item_object_id AND ai.delete_change_id IS NOT NULL ) WHERE ii.delete_change_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arr_item ai2 WHERE ai2.desc_item_object_id = ii.desc_item_object_id AND ai2.delete_change_id IS NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arr_item ai3 WHERE ai3.desc_item_object_id = ii.desc_item_object_id AND ai3.delete_change_id IS NOT NULL )
